body:

Please kindly add an option in iOS 27 Apple Calendar to create a “time-only” event without mandatory start and end duration.

Many professional users, business owners, and busy people only need a simple one-time booking reminder such as 4:25 PM — without the automatic one-hour block.

Please give users the choice to disable event duration completely if they wish.

It would make Apple Calendar much simpler, cleaner, and more practical for real-world daily use.

Thank you very much, and I sincerely hope Apple listens to long-time users on this matter in iOS 27, 

Then no doubt my review will change from this to 5 star straightaway, please email me, thank you 

Kind regards

body:
Here we go,

As well as organising my own life, I work in an industry where everything is determined by appointments between minuets to hours, and clients sometimes change appointments, so having an efficient calendar is key to working and organising life effectively. 

• It really must include a return travel time
• It needs to be rearranged in logical order. Maybe try the who, what, when, where, why, how, what else approach!
• Appointment slots should be before “all day”
• When revisiting the appointment to edit the Start Time, it really shouldn’t move the Finish Time, and visa-versa.

These points cause wasted time, distraction, and frustration. 

Overall, it’s a good calendar that needs adjusting.

title: Still errors
body:
After all these years, the calendar still has simple errors. It doesn't like you altering a repeating event. It will keep telling you 'event repeats before alert time', even when it doesn't and you haven't even changed the time, just the wording. 

Since they re-introduced the second alert - which has always been a brilliant idea by the way - some repeating items automatically give you an alert one hour before time, even when you've set the alerts to say 5 mins & ten mins. I had one today, and that's after I installed the latest update 20/4/23. I deleted the whole item and typed it in again. Waiting to see if it works now. 

Sometimes it's really really annoying when it wakes you an hour before something minor when you only wanted a 5 minute alert. 

There are items it won't let you delete, like some birthdays that were brought over from Facebook years ago, usually someone you hardly know. And it wakes you up at 8 or 9am to tell you. So unnecessary! I have a health condition made very much worse by being woken too early. 

Also some bank holidays it'll present as two or three events on the same day, some of which you can delete and some you can't. My day was filled with three 'Good Friday' alerts where one would have been plenty, and I didn't need to be woken up by them. 

I use my calendar a great deal, to remind me to take medication, help me wake up for things I do need to know, events happening, times to go to bed, favourite tv progs, all sorts of things. I can't believe how Apple can just idly let these things slide. Calendar worked much much better about 8 years ago.

I love the way I can add attachments, a URL, a telephone number (which then you can call simply by touching the phone logo) and Notes to each Calendar Entry. Also it takes you off to the URL (or Web address if included in Notes).

Also, I like the way it “picks up” the Location (Address) and takes you to🍏 Apple Maps…

However there are some glitches which are too complex to go into here… mainly to do with the App generating “double entries” for the exact same time and date… which show up when you search the Calendar BUT are NOT showing in the Actual Daily View (one page showing all entries for that Day).

If you “delete” ONE of the entries it (usually) deletes BOTH). Really strange is that you can Edit only one of the two entries (like add an ❌ in the Description) and they show up differently !!

It is WEIRD !!!

I sometimes completely “lose” an entry by trying to delete one of the “duplicates” and end up having to remember what was in it. I have learnt (the hard way) to “copy” ALL the details of an entry into an 🍏Apple Note (in the Notes App) BEFORE trying to delete one of the “duplicates”.

It really is ANNOYING !!!

I could go on about “little issues” but I think that’s enough for one Review.
